identity: Now that's a story.  Sometimes, we find places we call "labyrinths."  Stairs down to other worlds.  We keep track of them.  And, one is nearby, spotted by a novice Exodii, themselves.  That'd be the one you were trapped in, I believe.  So, I guess we're related, by circumstance, at least.  You're welcome here, and I'll remember and tell your story.
